headline: Timed Entry Reservations Required for Scenic Drive
reservation: A timed entry reservation is mandatory for the 13-Mile Scenic Drive from October through May. Reservations open in blocks on Recreation.gov; entry is separate from the America the Beautiful pass, and you must verify the specific hour on your digital confirmation at the ranger station.

days.title: Sandstone Scrambles and Colors

stops.name: Visitor Center Tortoise Habitat
stops.detail: View the protected Mojave Desert tortoises and learn about desert conservation before entering the loop.

stops.name: Calico Hills
stops.detail: Explore the brilliant red Aztec Sandstone mounds and natural water tinajas via the base trail.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour for the one-way loop drive; traffic moves slowly.
days.note: Reservations are strictly enforced; arrive within your designated time slot.

days.title: High Desert Overlooks

stops.name: High Point Overlook
stops.detail: Stand at 4,800 feet for a panoramic view of the Keystone Thrust and the distant Las Vegas valley.

stops.name: Petroglyph Wall
stops.detail: Take a short walk to view ancient rock art protected within the limestone cliffs.

days.driving: 30-minute transit to the park; 45 minutes on the interior loop.
days.note: The scenic drive is a one-way loop; you cannot backtrack to missed stops.

days.title: Hidden Canyons and Water

stops.name: Icebox Canyon
stops.detail: Hike into a deep, shaded canyon that remains significantly cooler and may hold seasonal waterfalls.

stops.name: Lost Creek Discovery Trail
stops.detail: Navigate this shorter, interpretive path to see desert flora and a small seasonal falls.

days.driving: Allow 2 hours for hiking time and loop completion.
days.note: Flash flood risks exist in canyons during late summer monsoon season.

intel.title: Trailhead Limits
intel.text: Sandstone Quarry and Calico Hills lots often reach capacity by mid-morning. If a lot is full, proceed to the next available pull-off; do not park on the one-way road.

intel.title: Red Rock Dead Zones
intel.text: Cellular signal drops significantly once inside the canyon loop. Download your timed entry QR code and maps before leaving the city limits of Summerlin.

intel.title: Last City Supplies
intel.text: There is no fuel or food available within the National Conservation Area. The final services are located in the Summerlin area or at the small store in Blue Diamond.

intel.title: Heat Awareness
intel.text: Summer temperatures regularly exceed 100°F; all strenuous activity should be completed before 10 AM. In winter, shaded canyons can be 15 degrees cooler than the visitor center.

intel.title: Rock Fragility
intel.text: Sandstone is highly porous and fragile when wet. Technical climbing and off-trail scrambling are prohibited for 24-48 hours following any rain to prevent stone breakage.

plan.arrival: Pick up rental vehicle at Boulder City (BLD) or Las Vegas; proceed to Summerlin for hydration supplies and sun protection before the park entrance.
plan.vehicle: Standard cars are fine for the paved 13-mile loop; high clearance is only necessary for the unpaved Rocky Gap Road which has strict rental restrictions.
plan.goldenHour: High Point Overlook offers the most expansive view for sunset, though the park gates close at specific seasonal times.
